newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia expects part of Saudi barley tender.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia expects part of Saudi barley tender.

text.p: Australia was likely to win some of the Saudi Arabian tender for 1.2 million tonnes of barley expected to be announced on Thursday, a spokesman for the NSW Grains Board told Reuters.
Robert Thompson, general manager marketing of the board, said values were expected to be about US$140.000 a tonne fob, with barley for February and March delivery.
Spokesmen for the Australian Barley Board, which markets barley from the states of South Australia and Victoria, were not immediately available for comment.
Thompson's statements follow U.S. reports that Canada was expected to take only up to 250,000 tonnes of the tender, with Australia and the European Union likely to take the rest.
